title: Hiller Aviation Museum
geometryBasis: The named and addressed museum outline, native terrain and the cleared Qualla frontage photograph are used with the institution’s public venue dimensions.
sectionBasis: A stepped airport museum shell with a blue panel frontage, recessed lower bays, a broad gallery and an atrium adjoining the far ranges. A white canard and winglet aircraft is displayed above the front roofline.
limitations: Height, roof drains and window positions on the less photographed elevations are estimated. The painted façade artwork is represented by its broad cladding colors. The model scope is the museum building and static rooftop display.
